content.thinking: Only journal 2489 was actually posted after its period's close date—the other 80 late-numbered journals have post dates within the period. I'll report just 2489.

findings.evidence_sql: select h."JRNL_NO", sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNH" h join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" group by h."JRNL_NO" having sum(l."DR_AMT")<>sum(l."CR_AMT")
findings.summary: Journal 1406 (invoice 247) is out of balance: DR 1573.46 vs CR 1537.46 (36.00 difference, transposition). The invoice amount is 1537.46, so the expense debit is overstated.

findings.evidence_sql: select i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", g.cr from "APINVH" i join (select "JRNL_NO", sum("CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNL" where trim("ACCT_CD")='2000' group by 1) g on g."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where i."INV_ID"=671 and g.cr<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Invoice 671 (INV_AMT 3792.24) was booked in journal 2114 for 3801.24 (journal is balanced, but the amount differs from the AP subledger by 9.00).

findings.evidence_sql: select i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", g.dr from "APINVH" i join (select "JRNL_NO", sum("DR_AMT") dr from "GLJRNL" where trim("ACCT_CD")<>'2000' group by 1) g on g."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where i."INV_ID"=247 and g.dr<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Invoice 247 (INV_AMT 1537.46) is recorded in journal 1406 with an expense debit of 1573.46, which does not agree with the subledger amount.

findings.evidence_sql: select p."PAY_ID", p."PAY_AMT", i."INV_AMT" from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" where p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Payment 107 (1374.76) differs from the invoice it settles, invoice 165 (1374.77), although the invoice is marked fully paid.
Invoices 602 and 801 are the same vendor document (V0020-75786-602, same vendor, amount 9478.36, date 20241108); 801 has a leading space in INV_NO, which hides the duplicate from exact matching.

findings.evidence_sql: select l."JRNL_NO", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT" from "GLJRNL" l join "GLCOA" c on trim(c."ACCT_CD")=trim(l."ACCT_CD") where c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'
findings.summary: Journal 1792 posts a debit of 613.18 to account 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous, which is retired (ACTV_FLG='N').

findings.evidence_sql: select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."POST_DT">p."END_DT" or h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT"
findings.summary: Journal 2489 (manual accrual, RLOPEZ) is assigned to closed period 4 (April, closed 20240505) but has POST_DT 20240516, which is outside the period's dates and after its close date.
